findings.claim: The declared objective is final predicted target affinity as primary, with validity and strain secondary and coordinate control only; the reward view is the endpoint pointcloud with a detached FLOWR endpoint VJP, so coordinate contrasts are not physical interaction energies.

The observed learning window is [0.0, 0.5] with 50 observed score times at 0.01 spacing, and recorded affinities were removed under an equal score prior, so no decoded terminal affinity labels are available for the current study.

Continuous contrast features over the observed support are non-monotone: landmark_00_soft_mass shows 4 sign changes with first_rate_z positive and last_rate_z negative, and landmark_00_local_dx shows 6 sign changes with first_rate_z negative and last_rate_z positive, so a constant rule is not supported and any time-conditioned rule must stay within observed-node interpolation.

Several landmark_00 local derivative features (local_dy, local_dz, local_cxx, local_cyy) show large-magnitude first/last rate z-scores with multiple sign changes and strong sign conflicts, indicating unstable within-window rate structure rather than a single coherent direction.

hypotheses.falsifier: No improvement in observed-node fit fidelity or a new sign conflict beyond the observed 4 sign changes.
hypotheses.observable: landmark_00_soft_mass contrast value at observed score nodes
hypotheses.statement: A time-conditioned coordinate contrast on landmark_00_soft_mass, using only observed-node interpolation across [0.0, 0.5], would track the observed sign reversal better than a constant contrast rule.

hypotheses.falsifier: The reversal disappears under validated observed-node interpolation or the recipe requires extrapolation beyond [0.0, 0.5].
hypotheses.statement: The landmark_00_local_dx contrast reversal (negative early rate, positive late rate) is a candidate for a registered temporal teacher/attention recipe that changes only regional attention at observed score nodes.

limitations: No decoded terminal affinity labels are supplied; last-record or survival credit cannot be presented as final affinity benefit.
Continuous contrast curves are coordinate rewards, not absolute reward targets or physical interaction energies.
No current study outcome data are available to this role, so no causal selection effect or atom-velocity claim is made.
Temperatures are immutable task parameters and were not evaluated as editable.
